brief.product: A member portal for a credit union with eleven branches. Members sign in a few times a month to check balances, move money between accounts, and follow a loan application through its stages. Most members are over fifty and use a phone or a tablet.
brief.notes: Members are not finance people, so plain words rather than banking jargon. Nothing that looks like a trading terminal. A lot of members use this on a tablet on the sofa, so tap targets matter more than density.

accent.why: A deep teal-blue avoids the plain navy every bank uses while still reading as steady and trustworthy for members moving their own money.

temperature.why: Members over fifty using this on the sofa are people first, and a warm grey beside a teal accent feels like a credit union rather than a trading terminal.

pairing.why: Most members are over fifty on a phone or tablet, so Atkinson Hyperlegible's legibility matters more than character.

radius.why: A consumer-facing portal opened a few times a month by ordinary members suits round corners over anything sharp and technical.

density.why: Members are occasional users tapping on a tablet, not trained staff working all day, so tap targets come before density.

motif.why: The sidebar shell defaults to the accent bar, and it marks the active section quietly without blocks of colour that could read as alarm.

copy.headline: Your accounts, in plain words
copy.tagline: Check your balance, move money between accounts, and see where your loan stands.
copy.why: The brief asks for plain words rather than banking jargon, so the copy names the three things a member came to do.
